Livestock Weighted Average Report for 10/26/2026 - Final

AUCTION
                                                          This Week                 Last Reported                     Last Year
                                                                                     10/19/2026
Total Receipts:                                            400                         358                            586
Slaughter Cattle:                                          192(48.0%)                 192(53.6%)                      393(67.1%)
Replacement Cattle:                                        208(52.0%)                 166(46.4%)                      193(32.9%)

Compared to last week: Slaughter cows steady to 3.00 lower. Slaughter bulls 3.00 lower. Slaughter demand moderate. No trend to set on
return to feed cows but a few buyers who were absent last week returned this week, helping to improve demand slightly on return to feed
cows. Supply included: 48% Slaughter Cattle (88% Cows, 12% Bulls); 52% Replacement Cattle (9% Stock Cows, 82% Bred Cows, 2% Bred
Heifers, 6% Cow-Calf Pairs).

Please Note:
The above USDA LPGMN price report is reflective of the majority of classes and grades of livestock offered for sale.
There may be instances where some sales do not fit within reporting guidelines and therefore will not be included in
the report. Prices are reported on an FOB basis, unless otherwise noted.

Explanatory Notes:
Stage (Cattle) - Represents pregnancy stage (O = open; T1 = 1st Trimester, 1 to 3 months; T1-2 = 1st/2nd trimester, 1
to 6 months; T2 = 2nd Trimester, 4 to 6 months; T2-3 = 2nd/3rd Trimester, 4 to 9 months; T3 = 3rd Trimester, 7 to 9
months; T1-3 = all trimesters, 1 to 9 months)

Age - Numerical representation of age in years.
